problem_text:
A logistics coordinator must assign a set of fragile shipments to identical reinforced pallets for air transport. The shipments are as follows:

* Component Alpha: 65 kg
* Component Beta: 68 kg
* Component Gamma: 61 kg
* Component Delta: 36 kg
* Component Epsilon: 60 kg
* Component Zeta: 65 kg
* Component Eta: 52 kg
* Component Theta: 51 kg
* Component Iota: 36 kg
* Component Kappa: 30 kg
* Component Lambda: 45 kg
* Component Mu: 44 kg
* Component Nu: 61 kg
* Component Xi: 49 kg
* Component Omicron: 47 kg
* Component Pi: 44 kg
* Component Rho: 30 kg
* Component Sigma: 61 kg
* Component Tau: 52 kg
* Component Upsilon: 62 kg
* Component Phi: 51 kg
* Component Chi: 35 kg

Each pallet has a certified maximum safe load capacity of 100 kilograms. The coordinator must devise a loading plan that places every shipment onto exactly one pallet, without exceeding the weight limit on any pallet, with the overarching objective of minimizing the total number of pallets required for the entire consignment.
